combinators that are useful to capsules, caches, wire formats, benchmarks,
and compiler/runtime proof blades without depending on host string layout.

docs: Canonical root math stdlib for Kain.
This is the engine-facing math surface for native LLVM, shaders, UI,
graphics, simulation, procedural generation, and GPU layout authoring.
It favors explicit data layouts and free functions so the surface stays
stable across Kain's current compiler/runtime lanes.
